appMenu.exportHostsWithSecrets: Export encrypted server list with credentials

general.terminalRetainedLines: Terminal Retained Lines per SSH Tab

security.desktopLoginRequired: Require login when desktop app starts
security.desktopLoginRequiredHint: Web access always requires login. When this is off, the local desktop app can enter with the existing secure local session.
security.webAccessEnabledHint: When disabled, browser-based web login is blocked and only the local desktop app can access the service.

ai.agentThinkingHelp: Global switch controls whether Agent is allowed to think; each model can also enable or disable thinking individually. Claude native protocol uses independent thinking parameters and event streams.
ai.predictionSectionHint: Use shorter context for faster, cheaper command suggestions with better cache reuse.
ai.assistSectionHint: Keep a little more context here so troubleshooting and multi-step operations stay reliable.
ai.modelHelp: OpenAI/Ollama uses /chat/completions; Claude native protocol uses /v1/messages with x-api-key.

providerHelp.openaiCompatible: Use OpenAI-compatible chat completion APIs such as OpenAI, DeepSeek, or Qwen.
providerHelp.anthropicClaude: Use Claude native Messages API with x-api-key authentication and event-driven streaming.

placeholders.ollamaApiKey: Usually no API key is needed for Ollama

ai.providerTimeoutHint: If remote Ollama or a large model is slow on first load, increase this to 120-300 seconds.
ai.overrideSystemPrompt: Override default system prompt (the prompt above will fully replace the built-in prompt instead of appending to it)
ai.systemPromptHint: Used for unified AI chat and Agent tasks, and sent to the Go core with each request.

skills.title: AI Skills
skills.help: Save reusable work instructions here. During AI chat you can check one or more skills to guide how the assistant should work.
skills.name: Skill Name
skills.promptPlaceholder: For example: Prefer read-only commands first, explain findings clearly, and avoid service restarts unless explicitly requested.

serverManagement.title: Server Management
serverManagement.summary: Centralized maintenance of SSH servers, groups, authentication methods, and import/export.

serverList.name: Server List
serverList.description: Display servers by group, support searching by name, address, and port.
serverList.usage: Select a server in the left SSH panel, double-click or click to create a new session.

groupManagement.name: Group Management
groupManagement.description: Create groups for servers to distinguish environments, businesses, or customers.
groupManagement.usage: Open group management from session menu or left toolbar, adjust and save.

importExport.name: Import/Export
importExport.description: Export server list or complete software configuration, can also export with encrypted credentials.
importExport.usage: Select import or export from file menu, desktop version will prefer using files.

serverReorder.name: Server Reorder
serverReorder.description: Support moving up/down to adjust server display order in the list.
serverReorder.usage: Click the top-right menu of server card, select move up or move down.

terminalSession.title: Terminal Session
terminalSession.summary: Manage multiple SSH sessions, retain terminal output, and track remote paths.

multiSession.name: Multi-Session Tabs
multiSession.description: Each server can open independent session tabs.
multiSession.usage: Create session from left server list, switch or close in middle tab bar.

commandHistory.name: Command History
commandHistory.description: Record reusable commands, support copy, execute, and favorite.
commandHistory.usage: Switch to history or favorites on the right, click command to fill or execute.

terminalContext.name: Terminal Context
terminalContext.description: AI reads recent terminal output, current command, and directory as context.
terminalContext.usage: Adjust terminal context character count and retained lines in settings.

aiAssistant.title: AI Assistant
aiAssistant.summary: Unified Q&A, error explanation, command generation, and Agent execution entry.

modelConfig.name: Model Configuration
modelConfig.description: Support multiple OpenAI compatible models and Ollama models, and select current active item.
modelConfig.usage: Add model in Settings > AI; Ollama address fill to /v1, e.g., http://host:11434/v1.

unifiedInput.name: Unified AI Input
unifiedInput.description: Directly input questions, goals, or let AI generate commands based on terminal content.
unifiedInput.usage: Input requirements in right AI panel, Ctrl+Enter or send button to submit.

agentMode.name: Agent Mode
agentMode.description: Review mode requires manual command execution, auto mode automatically advances low-risk commands, full-auto mode directly executes all commands.
agentMode.usage: Select review, auto, or full-auto below AI input box; full-auto mode will not intercept high-risk commands.

thinkingControl.name: Thinking Control
thinkingControl.description: Can disable Agent thinking to reduce long reasoning time for some models.
thinkingControl.usage: Disable Enable Agent Thinking in Settings > AI.

commandPrediction.name: Command Prediction
commandPrediction.description: Predict next possible command based on terminal context.
commandPrediction.usage: View prediction in terminal area, enable prediction thinking to observe model reasoning fragments.

customPrompt.name: Custom Prompt
customPrompt.description: Support completely overriding the default system prompt to customize AI behavior rules.
customPrompt.usage: Fill custom prompt in Settings > AI, then check the override option.

longTaskOptimization.name: Long Task Optimization
longTaskOptimization.description: Increase token/context/steps limits, intelligent command timeout, and output truncation.
longTaskOptimization.usage: Suitable for installation, deployment, and other long tasks; Agent can automatically execute multi-step operations.

batchTask.title: Batch Task
batchTask.summary: Select multiple servers, let AI execute the same natural language task in sequence.

batchSelection.name: Batch Selection
batchSelection.description: Enable batch mode on the left and check target servers.
batchSelection.usage: The right AI area shows selected server tags; click x on a tag to uncheck.

sequentialExecution.name: Sequential Execution
sequentialExecution.description: Batch task connects servers in checked order and advances Agent.
sequentialExecution.usage: Input the task description and click the lightning button; execution cards show each status.

finalSummary.name: Final Summary
finalSummary.description: After batch completion, summarize successes, failures, and each execution summary.
finalSummary.usage: View batch task records and the final summary in AI conversation history.

fileTransfer.title: File & Transfer
fileTransfer.summary: Browse remote directories, preview, edit, and transfer files.

filePanel.name: File Panel
filePanel.description: View current server directory, sort, and browse files.
filePanel.usage: Open the file panel from the top transfer menu, and you can also follow the current terminal directory.

previewEdit.name: Preview & Edit
previewEdit.description: Text files can be previewed and edited directly, and images and videos can be previewed.
previewEdit.usage: Open a file in the list, edit it, and save back to the remote server.

uploadDownload.name: Upload & Download
uploadDownload.description: Support uploading local files to the remote directory and downloading remote files.
uploadDownload.usage: Use the transfer menu or file panel buttons to start transfers.

logSecurity.title: Log & Security
logSecurity.summary: View runtime logs, adjust login policies, and troubleshoot AI/provider issues.

runtimeLog.name: Runtime Log
runtimeLog.description: View runtime records for core, AI, authentication, and UI.
runtimeLog.usage: Search source=ai or interface paths in Tools > Logs to troubleshoot issues.

webLogin.name: Web Login
webLogin.description: Require web access login and optionally require desktop startup login.
webLogin.usage: Adjust login policies or change passwords in Settings > Security.

errorNotification.name: Error Notification
errorNotification.description: The bottom-right error card shows source, endpoint, and detailed information.
errorNotification.usage: When encountering AI or SSH errors, check the details first, then inspect full context in logs.

keyboardShortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
keyboardShortcuts.summary: Shortcut list to improve operation efficiency.

global.name: Global Shortcuts
global.description: Ctrl+N creates a new session, Ctrl+W closes a session, Ctrl+Tab switches sessions, and Ctrl+, opens settings.
global.usage: Global shortcuts work from any interface.

terminal.name: Terminal Shortcuts
terminal.description: Ctrl+C copy, Ctrl+V paste, Ctrl+L clear screen, Tab accept prediction.
terminal.usage: Use these in the terminal area; Tab accepts the AI predicted command.

ai.name: AI Shortcuts
ai.description: Ctrl+Space triggers prediction, Ctrl+Enter sends a message, and Escape clears input.
ai.usage: Use shortcuts in the AI input box to work faster.

multiLanguage.title: Multi-Language Support
multiLanguage.summary: Support Chinese/English switching for international teams.

languageSwitch.name: Language Switch
languageSwitch.description: Switch the interface language in settings and support Chinese and English.
languageSwitch.usage: Settings > General > Language, then select Chinese or English.

autoSave.name: Auto Save
autoSave.description: Language preference is saved locally and applied again on next startup.
autoSave.usage: No manual save is needed after switching language.

fileBrowser.title: Remote Files
fileBrowser.uploadFolderToCurrent: Upload a folder to the current directory
fileBrowser.dropFolderUseButton: Drag and drop supports files only. Use Upload Folder for directories.
fileBrowser.fileTitle: Click to select, Ctrl/Shift for multi-select, double-click to preview, right-click to download, drag out for quick download

filePreview.unsupported: Direct preview is not supported for this file type yet
filePreview.titleIndentMore: Increase indentation for selected lines in {{name}}
filePreview.titleIndentLess: Decrease indentation for selected lines in {{name}}
filePreview.titleToggleComment: Toggle comment for selected content in {{name}}

aiWorkspace.viewingHistory: You are viewing history. Live tasks continue writing into the current SSH task conversation.
aiWorkspace.aiDisabled: AI Agent is turned off. You can enable it in Settings.
aiWorkspace.providerMissing: Configure a model endpoint and model in Settings, then save before using AI.
aiWorkspace.emptyConversation: No messages in this conversation yet. You can directly enter a question or a goal.
aiWorkspace.streaming: AI is streaming a reply in real time. Messages continue appearing in order.

input.defaultPlaceholder: Tell AI what you want to do, for example: explain this error, summarize logs, generate commands to install nginx, or help me complete a server operation.
input.batchPlaceholder: Batch task: describe the task in natural language, such as updating apt or checking disk space, then click Send on the right to start.

skills.label: Skills
skills.menuHint: Select one or more reusable skill prompts

review.label: Review
review.title: AI suggests commands and waits for you to execute them manually

auto.label: Auto
auto.title: Low-risk commands run automatically, while high-risk commands still wait for confirmation

fullAuto.label: Full Auto
fullAuto.title: All AI-generated commands run automatically without extra review or confirmation

actions.continueTask: Let AI plan the next step
actions.send: Send to the unified AI assistant

terminalStage.addSelectionToAI: Add selected terminal text to AI input
terminalStage.emptyTitle: Choose a server to start an SSH session
terminalStage.emptySubtitle: Double-click a server card on the left to connect directly, or start from a recently connected server.
terminalStage.recentHostsHint: Restore common server connections from here
terminalStage.addHostHint: Add a server first to get started
terminalStage.addConnectionHint: After saving, double-click a server card to connect
terminalStage.resizePredictionPanel: Drag to resize AI prediction area
terminalStage.autoPredictionHint: When enabled, only manually typed commands trigger next-step prediction
terminalStage.predictionHint: On an empty command line, press Tab to cycle suggestions and Enter to run the current one. Press Shift+Tab to retrigger prediction, Ctrl+Insert to copy selected text, and typing any other character clears suggestions.

modelsDialog.title: AI models
modelsDialog.heading: Model configuration
modelsDialog.help: Manage multiple AI model endpoints in one table. You can choose a default model, a dedicated AI/Agent model, and a separate command prediction model.

skillsDialog.title: AI skills
skillsDialog.heading: Skill library
skillsDialog.help: Store reusable instructions here. Checked skills in AI chat will be sent as extra operating guidance.

placeholders.secret: Used automatically when connecting after save

privateKey.supportsLocal: You can choose a local private key file
